start:
Hi! I'm — Pulse Bot 🤖.
I will help you keep your finger on the pulse of the main news without the extra noise.
Just add a channel, and I'll start preparing a digest of the most interesting stuff for you!

get_pulse.post_limit: Select the number of posts for me to analyze:
get_pulse.empty: No channels found for analysis! Please add a channel first.

history.channels: This is the knowledge archive. Here are all the digests I've prepared for you before. What would you like to review?
history.empty: The channel list is empty! Add a channel first.
history.summaries: All digests are sorted by creation date. Which date would you like to view?
history.summaries_empty: There are no digests yet! Create new digests

add.wait_for_link:
Ready to expand your information flow!
Send me a link to a Telegram channel (e.g., @channel_name or t.me/link).
add.not_username: This username is not in use!
add.not_exist_or_private: This channel doesn't exist or is private!

channel_list.channels: Here are the channels I'm subscribed to. You can manage subscriptions or view statistics for each.
channel_list.empty: The channel list is empty! Add a channel first.
channel_list.delete: Are you sure you want to delete the channel?

settings.change_language: Here you can change the interface and digest text language:
